reasoning_content: **"Application startup complete"** — the display server signed in to Biletado, fetched the reservable resources, and launched the cache loop. Next is the documented verification: curl the resource's HTML page.

action.command: docker compose logs 2>&1 | grep -E "BASE URL|SIGNIN|Updated|Cache|error|Error" | head; echo ====SINGLE====; curl -s -o /tmp/single.html -w 'single:%{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:8001/resources/Raum%20A'; head -c 700 /tmp/single.html; echo; echo ====IDS====; curl -s -o /tmp/ids.html -w 'ids:%{http_code}\n' 'http://localhost:8001/resources?ids=Raum%20A'; head -c 700 /tmp/ids.html
